n: Science on Stage Climapse micro:bit data acquisition
t: A short micro:bit unit on logging and graphing temperature data in science.
steps: Open the MakeCode tutorial links from Science on Stage.
Gather micro:bits and a PC or tablet for each group.
Add DHT11 or DHT22 sensors and crocodile clips for the optional task.
Try Tutorial 1 yourself to read temperature and send it to the PC.
Remind students that the built-in sensor reads board temperature. It needs calibration.
Run Tutorial 2 and Tutorial 3 to send, receive, and draw a diagram.
Export the CSV file for spreadsheet analysis.
